name: Crispy Pan-Fried Tofu with Lemony Spinach, Dill & Artichoke Rice

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
473 ml chicken or vegetable broth
salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 lemon

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, roughly chop spinach. Place in a medium bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the spinach.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add cornstarch, sugar, and spices, then stir to combine the the spice mixture. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp cornstarch
2 tsp brown sugar
1 tsp oregano, dried
1 tsp paprika
salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half crosswise and place on a plate. Spread half of the mayo over top side of the tofu, then sprinkle with half of the spice mixture (pressing gently to adhere). Carefully flip tofu and repeat with remaining mayo and spice mixture.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the rice is done, add to the bowl with the spinach and artichoke. Stir until spinach is slightly wilted and rice is combined, about 2 minutes.
Juice reserved lemon over the rice, then stir once more to combine.
To serve, divide spinach-artichoke rice and crispy tofu between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
